verification_policy: These records are sourced from the structured research corpus and remain partially_verified until acquisition, mechanics, and CaC availability are independently reconciled against canonical in-game evidence.

verification_audit.method: Rechecked the three records against the Madreag corpus and independent Xenoverse 2 reference pages. Big Bang Attack and Big Bang Kamehameha have corroborated core identity, cost, and shop/acquisition information; Backflip has corroborated identity and zero-cost movement behavior. All remain partially_verified because CaC availability and some version-sensitive mechanics are not independently reconciled to sufficient canonical evidence.

records.name: Backflip
records.unlock_method: Skill Shop after completing the Raditz's Attack story saga; research corpus reports a 1,000 Zeni purchase.
records.skill_description: A backward flip that dodges attacks, with additional input allowing repeated flips.
records.mechanics_notes: The source reports zero Ki, zero stamina, and zero damage. It relies on displacement rather than guaranteed invincibility frames, so tracking attacks can still connect.
records.combo_notes: Primarily defensive movement and spacing; repeated input can increase retreat distance.
records.pve_notes: Provides a resource-free retreat option against basic melee pressure, but is less reliable against tracking attacks.
records.pvp_notes: Can preserve Ki and stamina while creating distance, but opponents can catch displacement-based movement with tracking attacks.

records.name: Big Bang Attack
records.unlock_method: TP Medal Shop; research corpus reports a 15 TP Medal regular-rotation purchase.
records.skill_description: Creates a charged Ki sphere that can damage the target during its formation and then launch as a projectile.
records.mechanics_notes: The source reports that damage begins during the charge rather than only at launch, with roughly six observed hit events through a full sequence. The forming sphere can absorb minor Ki Blasts; exact current damage scaling remains partially verified.
records.combo_notes: Most useful when the target is held in place, such as after a knockdown or stamina-break setup, because the charge must remain near the opponent to exploit its contact damage.
records.pve_notes: Can apply repeated point-blank damage and provide some protection against minor projectile pressure, while its ranged version is comparatively slow.
records.pvp_notes: The immediate charge damage can create pressure at close range, but opponents can punish or disengage during the setup.

records.name: Big Bang Kamehameha
records.unlock_method: TP Medal Shop Limited-Time rotation; research corpus reports a 30 TP Medal purchase while stocked.
records.skill_description: A chargeable tracking Ki Wave that requires sufficient charge before it fires.
records.mechanics_notes: The source reports a minimum charge requirement, with an undercharged attempt doing nothing and preserving the resource. Community measurements in the corpus report approximately 20% at minimum viable charge and 30% at maximum charge, with the charging orb providing attack absorption; exact current scaling remains partially verified.
records.combo_notes: Best used after stun, knockdown, or stamina-break setups that give enough time to charge; the undercharge behavior can also function as a resource-safe feint.
records.pve_notes: High damage for a 100-Ki slot when enemies are controlled, with tracking and charge-based scaling useful against stationary or stunned targets.
records.pvp_notes: Strong when the opponent cannot interrupt the charge, but open-neutral use exposes the startup and gives mobile opponents counterplay.
